comments: Input facts: intersection-cross-traffic; both partners are cars; ego is the initiator and agent1 the responder; both planned intersection paths cross. Chosen assumptions: four-way junction, lateral approaches, 12-24 m initial approach clearance, nonzero initial speeds equal to trajectory target speeds (m/s), and ego reaching the crossing 0.1-0.45 s before agent1 under constant-speed estimates. The crossing opportunity is intentional; no collision is required. Ego crosses straight without yielding to agent1 approaching from the left. Agent1 continues during a reaction delay, brakes, and resumes its straight crossing after ego clears. Braking is triggered only after ego enters its connecting lane and the partners are within 14-17 m; brake control 0.65-0.85 is held until ego leaves that lane and separation reaches 12 m. The response delay is 0.25-0.45 s.
